title: The SwiftBar panel has a dedicated RSI section, and the icon shows when an RSI release is in its canary
acceptance: src/ilk2/xbar.py: (1) a section titled 'RSI' lists, from rsi_landings and rsi_candidates: the landing in progress with its stage (merged, released with the canary's minutes left, verified with the hours until the rezmac push), version, batch id and candidate title; the last 5 landings as '<version>  <candidate title>  <status>' each with a submenu item that copies 'git -C <repo> show --stat <merge_commit>' to the clipboard; one line '<open> open candidates · planning: <title> · today <n>/3 batches'; one line 'landing: on' or 'landing: off (rsi_land)'. (2) the menu title gains the suffix ' ↻' while a landing is in status 'released' (an RSI release in its canary), in every title state except the red ✗. (3) main() still never raises: without the rsi tables the section is omitted. Tests in tests/test_xbar.py pin each of these with render() on hand-built inputs; docs/02-architecture.md's SwiftBar paragraph describes the section and the ↻ sign in one or two sentences.

title: The SwiftBar panel shows the default worker model and the model each running batch is using (as V1's panel did)
acceptance: src/ilk2/xbar.py, as in V1's tools/xbar/render_xbar.py (global 'worker model' line, per-row 'model' line): (1) a line 'worker model: <m>' near the top of the menu, where <m> is the worker template's configured model: the top-level "model" key of <ilk2 home>/worker-template/settings.json (paths.home()), else its env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Read ONLY those two keys: never read, print or log any other key of that file (it holds credentials). When live workers run a model that differs from the configured one, append '  (live: <models, comma-separated, sorted>)'. (2) under each running batch, a submenu line '--model: <m>' with the model its live attempt actually runs: the "model" field of the first {"type": "system", "subtype": "init"} event in that attempt's worker log (the newest *.jsonl under the run directory's attempt logs, paths.run_dir(run_id)/<attempt id>/logs/; each line is {"t": ..., "ev": {...}}), read at most the first 200 lines; omit the line when no init event is found yet. (3) main() never raises: an unreadable template or log just omits the line. Tests in tests/test_xbar.py with a template and logs written under the test's ILK2_HOME pin: the configured line, the live suffix when they differ and none when equal, the per-batch line, and that a template with an auth token key never puts that value in the output. docs/02-architecture.md's SwiftBar paragraph mentions both in one sentence.
